name: OpenWeatherMap
label: OpenWeatherMap
description: OpenWeatherMap official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: weather_current, weather_forecast5, onecall, geo_direct. Docs: https://openweathermap.org/current. OpenWeather terms. One Call 3.0 is a separate SKU. Do not use retired /data/2.5/onecall. Attribution required when displaying. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One OpenWeatherMap request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"weather_current"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: weather_current | weather_forecast5 | onecall | geo_direct. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'weather_current'.

schema.label: exclude
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `exclude` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: lang
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `lang` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: lat
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `lat` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `limit` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: lon
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `lon` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `q` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: units
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `units` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: weather_current, weather_forecast5, onecall, geo_direct.

configurationParameters.label: Appid
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Units
configurationParameters.description: Units: standard | metric | imperial. Default metric.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 20. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
